'''Brian Casimiro''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2000 Virginia Beach tournament]] on 24 September 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court (COTVG) with space]], according to Brian Catalino's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1269">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-24-virginia-beach-va-9-24-00d1269/ virginia-beach-va-9-24-00], DeckTech (brian "darkjedi2000" catalino, 24 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-24-virginia-beach-va-9-24-00d1269/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
